title: SEC3: make_whois duplicated between harness and e2e
description: harness.rs:75 defines make_whois(id, login) and e2e.rs:127 defines make_whois_resp(id, login). Both construct an identical WhoIsResponse from (id, login) with only cosmetic differences (node name format). If WhoIsResponse gains a required field both must be updated independently with no compiler error to catch the miss. A shared helper in a common test-utils module (or re-exported from the harness) would eliminate the drift risk.
